description.value: Mercante is an Italian restaurant in UBC's Ponderosa Commons, serving made-to-order traditional pizzas cooked in a stone hearth oven alongside pastas, salads, desserts, and specialty coffees. Part of UBC Food Services, it is one of more than 30 campus dining locations and caters primarily to the university community. Its location on the UBC campus makes it a convenient stop for cyclists exploring the university grounds or the Pacific Spirit Regional Park area.
